 Chris Fedek (Samsung Lions), the "Ace of the Lion Corps," once again showed a brilliant fighting spirit.
 Fedek took the mound as Samsung's starting pitcher in Game 2 of the 2026 KBO Korean Series (KS, best-of-seven) against KT Wiz at KT Wiz Park in Suwon on the 4th.
 Until this day, Samsung's atmosphere was not good. This is why he kneeled 7-8 in the first game of the previous day (3rd). He followed seven points in the second half after giving up eight points in the first half, but had to face a bitter defeat. After reaching the second place (83 wins, 3 draws and 58 losses) in the regular league, he failed to continue his momentum by beating the third-place KIA Tigers (79 wins, 2 draws and 63) in the playoff (PO, best-of-five series) with 3 wins and 2 losses overall. In the previous KS, the winning team of the first round has a whopping 73.8% (31/42).
 사진 확대 Game 2 of the Korean Series between the Samsung Lions and KT Wiz of the "2026 Shinhan SOL KBO League Postseason" was held at KT Wiz Park in Suwon on the 4th. In the bottom of the third inning, Samsung Fedek is happy when Ryu Ji-hyuk's defense is good. Photo (Suwon) = Reporter Chun Jung-hwan 사진 확대 Game 2 of the Korean Series between the Samsung Lions and KT Wiz of the "2026 Shinhan SOL KBO League Postseason" was held at KT Wiz Park in Suwon on the 4th. Samsung starter Fedek is pitching hard. Photo (Suwon) = Reporter Chun Jung-hwan In this situation, Samsung chose Fedek as the starting pitcher. Fedek is a right-hander with a brilliant career. In the 2015 draft, he was drafted by the Miami Marlins in the Major League Baseball (MLB) with a total of 236 in the eighth round, before passing through the San Diego Padres, Minnesota Twins, Cincinnati Reds and Texas Rangers. His overall big league record is 32 wins, 43 losses and a 4.83 ERA in 132 games (581.2 innings).
 His performance continued in the KBO League as well. He joined as a substitute for Jack O'Rourkelyn in the second half and recorded 7-3 with a 2.95 ERA in 13 games (76.1 innings). KT met in Daegu on August 29 and won with six hits, two outs and seven strikeouts in six innings.
 He also had a great presence in fall baseball. In the first game of the PO, he had only five hits, two homers, two homers, four strikeouts, and five runs (94 pitches), but after a three-day break, he started in the fourth game of the PO and pitched hard with six hits and one strikeout and one run in 5.1 innings. At that time, the number of pitches was 99.
 The start of the day was unsettling. In the bottom of the first inning, Choi Won-joon hit a double to left-center. Kim Min-hyuk (striker fly) and Ahn Hyun-min (three strikeouts) then defeated, but he walked Sam Hilliard and was driven to first and second bases with two outs. Fortunately, Kim Hyun-soo was induced to fly to left field, and the loss was suppressed.
 사진 확대 Game 2 of the Korean Series between the Samsung Lions and KT Wiz of the "2026 Shinhan SOL KBO League Postseason" was held at KT Wiz Park in Suwon on the 4th. Samsung Fedek and Diaz miss KT Han Seung-taek's infield fly ball in the bottom of the second inning with two outs. Photo (Suwon) = Reporter Chun Jung-hwan The bottom of the second inning was neat. Ryu Hyun-in (pitcher ground ball) and Heo Kyung-min (striker ground ball) were successively silenced. Han Seung-taek allowed him to get on base by making a fly ball catch error, but he struck out Jang Joon-won. In the bottom of the third inning, he also gave a hit to Choi Won-joon, but he overpowered Kim Min-hyuk (a grounder to catcher) and Ahn Hyun-min (a straight hit to second baseman). Immediately after, even Kim Min-hyuk, who could not return to first base, was out and the inning ended.
 The first run came in the bottom of the fourth inning. Hilliard's double to the left and Kim Hyun-soo's fly to center field faced third base with one out. Ryu Hyun-in, the follow-up hitter, defeated him with a ground ball to the second base, but Heo Kyung-min hit a timely RBI left-handed hit. He guided Han Seung-taek to a catcher foul fly and made no additional runs.
 At the end of the fifth inning, he settled down again. He gave up a hit to Jang Joon-won, but Choi Won-joon was treated as a double play by the first baseman. Kim Min-hyuk then cooked with a fly to left field.
 At the end of the sixth inning, his crisis management ability stood out. Ahn Hyun-min's strikeout, Hilliard's heavy hit, and Kim Hyun-soo's double to the right led to the second and third bases with one out, but Ryu Hyun-in and Heo Kyung-min were tied side by side with ground balls to the first base.
 Since then, Fedek, who came to the mound in the bottom of the seventh inning, has cleared Han Seung-taek and Jang Joon-won with a grounder to the third base and a grounder to the shortstop. Choi Won-joon allowed a hit to the right, but he finished his mission on the day by catching Kim Min-hyuk with a ground ball to the first base.
 The final result was eight hits in seven innings, one out, three strikeouts, and one run. The total number of pitches was 102. Samsung, with Fedek's all-out pitching at the forefront, is locked in a 1-1 tie with KT as of the end of the eighth inning. Following Fedek, left-hander Lee Seung-min took the mound.
 사진 확대 Game 2 of the Korean Series between the Samsung Lions and KT Wiz of the "2026 Shinhan SOL KBO League Postseason" was held at KT Wiz Park in Suwon on the 4th. In the bottom of the third inning, Samsung Fedek is making a high five with Ryu Ji-hyuk, who showed a good defense. Photo (Suwon) = Reporter Chun Jung-hwan [Lee Hanjoo, MK Sports Reporter]
